sources.title: inceptionai/Jais-2-70B-Chat-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Jais-2-70B-Chat Model is trained from scratch on Arabic and English data and is powered by a custom Arabic-centric vocabulary, it efficiently captures Modern Standard Arabic, regional dialects, and mixed Arabic-English code-switching.

sources.title: Jais 2: A Blueprint for Sovereign AI - cerebras.ai
sources.snippet: The Jais 2 chat application runs at 2,000 tokens per second, making it one of the fastest LLMs in the world. Jais 2 serves as a blueprint for sovereign AI, showing how nations can develop highly capable, culturally aligned models at lower cost, higher speed, and without the complexity of large GPU clusters.

sources.title: Jais 2: A Family of Arabic-Centric Open Large Language Models
sources.snippet: Jais 2 is a family of Arabic-centric large language models released jointly by MBZUAI, Cerebras, and Inception. The family includes a 70B model claimed to be the largest open Arabic-centric LLM trained from scratch, alongside a competitive 8B variant.
